strings: While looking the same as any other kit in the nursery there's a bit of a shock when m_c's eyes finally open. r_c0's quick to reassure the parents that a lazy eye isn't anything to worry too much about.
Even if m_c's eye seems a little bit different, it doesn't really bother {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c doesn't understand the fuss that everyone keeps making about {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eye. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/think/thinks} it makes {PRONOUN/m_c/object} look cool.

Despite being as healthy as any other kitten in the Nursery, m_c's been struggling to navigate and is dismayed to hear that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyesight might never be as clear as {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates'.
